svg.title: Checkout: the request path, step by step
svg.text: Checkout, step by step: what has to happen before you say "order placed"
Steps 1 to 6 are synchronous and sit on the shopper's click. Steps 7 to 9 happen after the response and can retry for hours without anyone noticing.
Subscribers: each has its own subscription and dead-letter topic, and dedupes on event_id
1 Shopper posts the order with an Idempotency-Key header (one per checkout attempt, made by the client).
2 The global LB routes to the nearest healthy region. Cloud Armor rate-limits checkout per session and per IP.
3 checkout reads the cart from Valkey, then re-prices it from Spanner. Never trust the cached price.
4 One Spanner read-write transaction: hold stock (reservation with a 15 min expiry), insert order PENDING, insert outbox row.
5 Score fraud, then authorise with the PSP through Cloud NAT, reusing the idempotency key. Timeout 8 s, no blind retries.
6 Second transaction: order AUTHORISED + outbox row. Respond "order placed" (or "pending") to the shopper.
7 PSP webhook lands on Cloud Run. Verify the signature, upsert payment state by PSP reference. Duplicates are no-ops.
8 An outbox relay (or a Spanner change stream) publishes each outbox row to Pub/Sub with its event_id.
9 Fulfilment, email, analytics and recommendations consume at their own pace. Failures go to a dead-letter topic.
